description: Implement or change React components and hooks following the project's own patterns, with accessible markup, correct state and effect handling, and Testing Library tests. Use when the user asks to add, change, or fix a component, hook, form, or client-side UI behavior in a project that uses React. Do not use for server endpoints or API routes (use kit-fastify-api or kit-feature-implementation), for Vue, Svelte, or other frameworks, or for reviewing code (use kit-code-review).
